rationale: The agent canceled the entire order without authenticating the user, without confirming the action, and without first attempting or explaining earlier user-preferred options (split payment, cancel most expensive item, or switch to cheaper variants). Policy requires authentication and explicit confirmation before any order-changing write; neither is shown. The agent also did not hand off to a human if splitting payments was unsupported. While it provided refund details, acting unilaterally to cancel violates the policy, so the outcome fails.
